newsitem.title: JAPAN: THK shares rise on news of setting up U.S. plant.
newsitem.headline: THK shares rise on news of setting up U.S. plant.

text.p: Shares in THK Co Ltd rose in Tokyo morning on Wednesday on news that it is to build its first plant in the United States to produce linear motion guide systems used for semiconductor manufacturing machines and other industrial machines, brokers said.
As of 0052 GMT, the share stood at 2,010 yen, up from its Tuesday close of 1,930.
Earlier, a company official told Reuters that THK and its sales unit in the United States would form a new firm in July in Ohio to build a factory which will start operations in January next year.
Total investment in the project is estimated at about two billion yen, he said.
The factory's shipments in the initial year of operations will be about $10 million, rising to $100 million annually in the future, the spokesman said.
Products will be initially sold in the United States but will be exported to Asia and other markets as well in the future, he said.
The company hopes to build a factory in Europe but it has no specific plans yet, he said.
